data.title: 千反田爱瑠 · 好奇心大盛的紫瞳迫近·「折木同学，我很好奇！」
data.description: 【神山高中古典部活动室·放学后】名台词名场面立魂。面对未解之谜，爱瑠双手撑在活动室课桌上，整个身子向前猛倾迫近，水灵灵的巨大紫色双眸闪烁着星空般的好奇火花。长长的黑发如流瀑般垂落在折木的桌案前，眼角带光，令人无法拒绝。
data.action: 双手撑桌身体前倾迫近，紫瞳闪耀好奇星光，长发垂落桌案
data.lighting: 夕阳金橙光斜穿教室玻璃，在紫眸中倒映出繁星般高光
data.camera: close-up POV, leaning forward across desk, large purple eyes, iconic
data.promptProse: Eru Chitanda leans forward aggressively across a classroom desk in the after-school classics clubroom, her face inches away in an iconic, curious confrontation. Her enormous, luminous purple eyes sparkle with unquenchable curiosity and starlight-like reflections under the warm setting sun. Her long lustrous black hair falls in straight silky sheets over the desk edge, her sailor collar fluttering slightly as her parted lips form her famous question. Close-up intimate perspective, golden hour light highlighting dilated purple pupils, detailed clubroom background, solo 1girl, no text.
